purpose: Preliminary development test of three zero-cost Step-4 handover operators: Teacher-Coupled Restart, coherence-gated DEH, Speech-Envelope Anchoring

operators.tcr: first student input = teacher state x(t_4) (tau_1 = t_4)
operators.cdeh: x1hat(t_4) + S(rho, 4) Delta_4 if cos(Delta_4, Delta_3) >= 0.2, else x1hat(t_4)
operators.sea: generated frames + 0.5 * (mu_prompt - mu_gen), per band, means over the louder half of the frames

primary_test: each operator vs plain Step 4 on the noisy conditions pooled (exact McNemar, two-sided)
criteria: C1 noisy Step-4 failures drop by at least 25% with p < 0.05
C2 clean Step-4 failures rise by at most 1
C3 pooled out-of-fold <op>_theta: lower mean NFE than snr_theta with no more failures
selection_rule: the operator passing the most criteria; ties broken by the lower pooled <op>_theta mean NFE
